After hearing such objections, the Competent Authority passed orders under the provisions of Section 20D of the said Act and submitted its report,under sub-section (1) of Section 20E of the said Act. Now, therefore, the Central Government, upon receipt of the report from the Competent Authority and in exercise of the powers conferred by sub-section (1) of Section 20E of the said Act, hereby declares that the land specified in the Schedule annexed hereto shall be acquired for the aforesaid purpose. And further, in exercise of the powers conferred under sub-section (2) of Section 20E of the said Act, Central Government hereby declares that, upon publication of this notification in the Gazette, the land specified in the Schedule annexed hereto shall vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.
